title: Modules
seo_title: Jasefly Modules — ZIP Packages and Platform SDK
seo_description: How modules extend Jasefly: in-repo Modules/, ZIP packages via Platform SDK, bootPlatform, capabilities, builder widgets, and quarantine — not a public marketplace.

settings.html: Extensibility is a first-class framework concern. You can ship in-repo modules under backend/src/Modules + frontend/src/modules, or distribute ZIP packages that boot through bootPlatform(PlatformContext). There is a Package Manager — not a public Module Marketplace store.

settings.title: What a module can do
settings.subtitle: Real registration surfaces — no invented APIs.

items.title: bootPlatform
items.body: Preferred package entry on AbstractPackageModule — register routes, capabilities, providers.

items.title: Access providers
items.body: Register AccessProvider implementations; content gates stay fail-closed.

items.title: Capabilities
items.body: registerCapability + registerAdminNavItem for admin ACL and navigation.

items.title: Events
items.body: events()->publish / subscribe for loose coupling across packages.

items.title: Quarantine
items.body: Failed ZIP install/update can isolate the package instead of crashing the host.
